title: Mall World as premonition?
content: In 2018, I had my first and only Mall World dream. In my dream, The Mall was seemingly empty but a part of me knew it wasn’t and I was also very scared. I remember being there and hiding because there were open shots being fired. I don’t know if there was anyone dead in the dream, but after the shots were fired, I remember *knowing* that other people were there and we were all threatened and running to new hiding places while we heard shots getting closer to us. The next day, the Parkland shooting happened.
